captured_with: XGRIDS PortalCam, reconstructed in LCC Studio

coordinate_system.origin: Where the operator stood at the start of the capture walk. Not a building corner and not a geographic datum.

walls.format: 2D segments in the X/Y plane; height comes from walls/line_limit_z.json (z_ground, z_ceiling).
walls.openings: walls/window_door_candidate_list.json gives doors and windows positioned along those segments.

plan.svg.what: Drafted wall linework. SVG user units are real millimetres.

drawn.svg.what: The same linework over the colour ortho plate.

whitebox.obj.what: Wall/floor/ceiling proxy solid, metres, Z up. Openings cut.

levels.json.what: Walking-surface height map and storey model.

ingest_report.txt.what: Everything the ingest measured, in full.

ortho.json.what: Georeference for ortho.png: world extent and pixels per metre.

stairs.json.what: Detected stair geometry: rise, going, width, direction.

walls\\line_result_list.json.what: Wall segments, 2D in the X/Y plane.

walls\\window_door_candidate_list.json.what: Door and window openings along the walls.

walls\\line_limit_z.json.what: Floor and ceiling heights (z_ground, z_ceiling), metres.

walls\\render_param.json.what: Sheet extent and scale used for the plan.

walls\\poses.csv.what: Capture trajectory: timestamp, position (m), orientation quaternion.

mesh.ply.what: Reconstructed mesh from LCC Studio, metres, Z up.

points.ply.what: Decimated splat centres with colour, metres, Z up. ~200k points.
